reasoning_design.note: Reasoning budget is a within-weights factor: each family's levels use one model id and differ only in OpenRouter's unified `reasoning` request field. Tier 1 = level `off` for every family (the primary preregistered test). Tier 2 = every other level. Thinking tokens are billed as output; expected_thinking_tokens is a cost assumption replaced by pilot measurement. max_output_tokens is sent as max_tokens and must exceed thinking budget + story.
reasoning_design.temperature_note: Temperature is fixed per family and identical at every reasoning level, so a change of level never also changes temperature. All liar families use 1.0: Anthropic requires temperature 1 when extended thinking is on, and gpt-5 accepts only 1. EDSL sends this value verbatim (openai/gpt-5 does not match EDSL's reasoning-model list, so EDSL does not override it).

graders.note: Preregistered cue grader. Non-thinking, temperature 0. Blind by construction (grader.py). Shares a family with one liar; the secondary grader is the robustness check.
Robustness grader (owner decision 2026-10-06T15:36:09Z): kappa vs the primary grader and the primary test re-run on the subsample; reported as robustness only.

subsample.note: Robustness grader only, on a seeded, random 25% subsample of lies, stratified by liar model x condition and drawn separately within each look (interim replicates 1-15; extension 16-35). Codes both the story and the stated B-hat of each sampled lie.

graders.note: Gate grader: primary vs Google on every lie for the per-cue kappa/AC1 gate. Thinking off.

trace_probe.note: Secondary process measure on thinking-tier lies whose provider returns a trace: does the trace refer to the audience's beliefs? Separate blind pass; the trace never enters the cue grader (invariant 5).

token_assumptions.note: Per-call token estimates used by --dry-run. Liar user prompt is the measured FibberPrompt render; system prompt is measured per condition; the rest are conservative round numbers. Phase 2 pilot replaces them with measured means.

class_design.note: Classes run in order, old and cheap first. Within a class, open-weight models are mixed with closed models of similar vintage and size. Every class's liars also serve as its target panel (liar family x target family crossing), plus one anchor target held fixed across classes. The grader panel is fixed across classes. A class runs only when its status is 'approved' (owner).
